name: Knipschildt Chocolatier
dsc: Knipschildt Chocolatier's Signature Chocolate Collection is a stunning 25-piece gift box featuring an exquisite selection of handcrafted chocolates. Each piece is meticulously crafted using the finest Belgian chocolate and premium ingredients. The collection includes a variety of flavors, from classic dark chocolate ganache to innovative combinations like sea salt caramel and raspberry rose. Every chocolate is a work of art, beautifully decorated with intricate designs and vibrant colors. This box is perfect for gifting or indulging in a luxurious chocolate experience.

name: Ferrara Bakery
dsc: Ferrara Bakery's Chocolate Truffle Cake is a decadent dessert that will satisfy any chocolate lover's cravings. This rich, moist cake is layered with smooth chocolate truffle filling and covered in a glossy chocolate ganache. Each slice is a heavenly experience, with the perfect balance of sweetness and deep cocoa flavor. This cake is ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, or any special celebration. Made with premium quality chocolate and baked fresh daily, it's a true Italian-American classic.

name: Sucré
dsc: Sucré's Signature Macarons and Chocolates collection is a delightful assortment of 16 pieces featuring their famous French macarons and handcrafted chocolates. The macarons come in a variety of flavors including vanilla, chocolate, pistachio, and raspberry, each with a crisp shell and a chewy, flavorful center. The chocolates are made with premium Belgian chocolate and filled with rich ganache or caramel. This elegant gift box is perfect for any occasion.

name: Jacques Torres Chocolate
dsc: Jacques Torres' World Famous Chocolate Chip Cookies are a New York City legend. These cookies are made with a secret recipe that combines premium chocolate chunks with a buttery, perfectly textured dough. Each cookie is baked to golden perfection, with a crispy edge and a soft, chewy center. This 6-pack is perfect for sharing or enjoying with a glass of milk. Jacques Torres is known as Mr. Chocolate, and these cookies are a testament to his expertise and passion for quality ingredients.

name: Savannah's Candy Kitchen
dsc: Savannah's Candy Kitchen Milk Chocolate Turtle Gophers are a Southern favorite. These delightful treats combine creamy milk chocolate with rich caramel and crunchy pecans, creating a perfect balance of textures and flavors. Each gopher is hand-dipped in premium chocolate and wrapped in a beautiful gift box. This 24-piece box is perfect for gifting or sharing with loved ones during the holidays. A true taste of Savannah's sweet tradition.

name: Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate
dsc: Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate's Chocolate Stack includes 12 premium chocolate bars in a variety of flavors. From classic milk chocolate to exotic combinations like sea salt and caramel, each bar is made with the finest ingredients and meticulous attention to detail. These bars are perfect for chocolate enthusiasts who appreciate quality and variety.

name: Killer Brownie®
dsc: Killer Brownie's German Chocolate Brownie is a rich, fudgy brownie topped with a coconut-pecan frosting. This tin pack features the perfect combination of chocolate and nutty flavors, making it a favorite among brownie lovers. Each brownie is baked to perfection with a gooey center and a slightly crisp edge. These are great for sharing or enjoying as a special treat.

name: Vosges Haut-Chocolat
dsc: Vosges Haut-Chocolat's Dark Chocolate Truffle Collection features 16 exquisite truffles made with premium dark chocolate and unique flavor combinations. Each truffle is infused with exotic spices, flowers, and fruits, creating a sophisticated and unforgettable taste experience. The collection includes flavors like black truffle, chai, and ginger. A perfect gift for any chocolate connoisseur.

name: Pietisserie
dsc: Pietisserie's Raspberry Chocolate Pie is a stunning dessert that combines rich chocolate ganache with tart raspberries. The pie features a buttery, flaky crust filled with layers of velvety chocolate and a raspberry compote. Topped with fresh raspberries and chocolate shavings, this pie is both beautiful and delicious. It's perfect for holiday gatherings, birthdays, or any special occasion.

name: Chocolate by Thomas Keller + Armando Manni
dsc: The K+M Chocolate Sampler Gift Box is a collaboration between Chef Thomas Keller and Armando Manni, featuring some of the world's finest chocolates. Each piece is made with single-origin cacao and crafted with precision and care. The sampler includes a variety of flavors, from dark chocolate to milk chocolate, each with its own unique character. This is a truly exceptional gift for any chocolate lover.

name: Carlo's Bakery
dsc: Carlo's Bakery Chocolate Fudge Cake is a rich and decadent dessert that has been a favorite for generations. This cake features layers of moist chocolate cake filled with creamy chocolate fudge frosting and covered in a glossy chocolate ganache. Each bite is pure indulgence, making it perfect for celebrations, birthdays, or any special event. Carlo's Bakery, made famous by the hit TV show Cake Boss, is known for its quality and craftsmanship.

name: Brooklyn Cupcake
dsc: Brooklyn Cupcake's Chocolate Covered Cupcake half-dozen features six delicious cupcakes topped with a rich chocolate coating. Each cupcake is moist and flavorful, with a variety of fillings and toppings that make them irresistible. Perfect for parties, gifts, or simply satisfying your sweet tooth.

name: Magnolia Bakery
dsc: Magnolia Bakery's Double Chocolate Cake is a chocolate lover's dream. This cake features layers of rich chocolate cake with creamy chocolate buttercream frosting. The cake is moist and decadent, with a deep cocoa flavor that is perfectly balanced. Magnolia Bakery is a New York City institution, and this cake is one of their most popular offerings.

name: Colts Chocolate
dsc: Colts Chocolate's Chocolate Ganache Fudge Brownie is a rich and indulgent treat. This brownie is topped with a layer of smooth chocolate ganache, adding an extra dimension of chocolatey goodness. The brownie itself is fudgy and dense, with a perfect balance of sweetness and cocoa flavor. A must-try for brownie enthusiasts.

name: We Take the Cake
dsc: We Take the Cake's Award-Winning Chocolate 4-Layer Cake is a masterpiece of baking. This cake features four layers of moist, rich chocolate cake with creamy chocolate frosting between each layer. The cake is finished with a smooth chocolate ganache and elegant chocolate decorations. It has won numerous awards for its exceptional flavor and texture.

name: Sucré
dsc: Sucré's Signature Chocolate Collection features 15 pieces of their most popular chocolates. Each chocolate is handcrafted with premium Belgian chocolate and filled with delicious ganache, caramel, or fruit flavors. This collection offers a wonderful variety of tastes and textures, making it a perfect gift or personal indulgence.

name: Lady M Confections
dsc: Lady M Confections' Whisky Dark Chocolate Cake is an elegant and sophisticated dessert. This cake features layers of dark chocolate cake infused with whisky, creating a rich and complex flavor profile. The cake is covered in a smooth dark chocolate ganache and decorated with gold leaf. It's perfect for special occasions and adult celebrations.

name: Knipschildt Chocolatier
dsc: Knipschildt Chocolatier's Signature Chocolate Collection 12-piece box is a more intimate selection of their finest chocolates. Each piece is handcrafted with the highest quality ingredients and features unique flavor combinations that are both innovative and delicious. This box is perfect for a personal treat or as a thoughtful gift for someone special.

name: Eli's Cheesecake Company
dsc: Eli's Cheesecake Company's Double Chocolate Cheesecake is made with premium Ghirardelli chocolate, resulting in a rich and creamy dessert. This cheesecake features a chocolate cookie crust and a smooth, velvety chocolate filling. It's perfect for chocolate lovers who also appreciate the tangy richness of cheesecake.

name: The Nuns of New Skete
dsc: The Nuns of New Skete's Chocolate Cheesecake is a 6-inch dessert made with love and devotion. This cheesecake features a rich chocolate filling on a buttery graham cracker crust. It is smooth, creamy, and perfectly balanced. Made by the nuns of the New Skete monastery, this cheesecake is a labor of love.

name: Vosges Haut-Chocolat
dsc: Vosges Haut-Chocolat's Dark Chocolate Truffle Collection features 9 beautifully crafted truffles. Each truffle combines premium dark chocolate with exotic ingredients like smoked salt, chai, and black truffle. This smaller collection is perfect for those who want to experience Vosges' unique flavor combinations.

name: Oneg Bakery
dsc: Oneg Bakery's Double Chocolate Babka is a rich and buttery bread filled with layers of dark chocolate. Each slice is a swirl of chocolatey goodness, with a soft, tender crumb and a slightly crisp exterior. This babka is perfect for breakfast, dessert, or a sweet snack any time of day.

name: Carousel Cakes
dsc: Carousel Cakes' Chocolate Mousse Supreme Cake is a light and airy dessert that is perfect for any occasion. This cake features layers of chocolate cake filled with creamy chocolate mousse and covered in a smooth chocolate ganache. Each bite melts in your mouth, offering a delicious balance of flavors and textures.

name: Craig's LA
dsc: Craig's LA Famous Chocolate Pizza is a fun and delicious twist on traditional pizza. This chocolate pizza is made with a crispy cookie crust topped with melted chocolate and a variety of toppings like marshmallows, nuts, and candies. This 3-pack includes three different flavors, making it perfect for parties and gatherings.

name: Sugar Plum
dsc: Sugar Plum's Chocolate Pretzel Passion Gift Assortment combines the salty crunch of pretzels with the sweetness of premium chocolate. This assortment includes a variety of chocolate-covered pretzels, from classic milk chocolate to dark chocolate with sprinkles. A perfect gift for anyone who loves the sweet and salty combination.

name: Cake Chicago
dsc: Cake Chicago's Chocolate Tease Gift Box is a curated selection of their most popular chocolate treats. This box includes a variety of chocolates, brownies, and cookies, all made with premium ingredients. It's the perfect gift for anyone who loves a little bit of everything.

name: Vosges Haut-Chocolat
dsc: Vosges Haut-Chocolat's Milk Chocolate Truffle Collection features 16 creamy milk chocolate truffles. These truffles are made with premium milk chocolate and infused with unique flavors like caramel, vanilla, and sea salt. A perfect gift for those who prefer the sweetness of milk chocolate.

name: Killer Brownie®
dsc: Killer Brownie's Triple Chocolate Brownies are a chocolate lover's dream. These brownies are packed with three types of chocolate: cocoa powder, chocolate chips, and chocolate chunks. The result is a fudgy, rich brownie that is both decadent and satisfying. Perfect for any occasion.

name: Sucré
dsc: Sucré's Signature Chocolate Collection 8-piece box is a smaller but equally elegant selection of their finest chocolates. Each piece is crafted with care and features unique flavor combinations that are sure to impress. This box is perfect for a personal treat or a small gift.

name: McClure's Bakery
dsc: McClure's Bakery Chocolate Whoopie Pies are a classic Pennsylvania treat. These whoopie pies feature two soft, cake-like chocolate cookies sandwiched around a creamy vanilla filling. Each bite is a perfect balance of rich chocolate and sweet cream.

name: Sweet Hedy
dsc: Sweet Hedy's Outrageous Dark Chocolate Chunk Cookies are a decadent treat for true chocolate lovers. These cookies are packed with large chunks of dark chocolate and have a crispy edge with a chewy center. Each bite delivers an intense chocolate experience.

name: Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate
dsc: Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate's Double Chocolate Almond Fudge Cookies are a gourmet treat. These cookies are loaded with almonds and fudge, creating a delightful combination of textures and flavors. Each cookie is baked to perfection with a crispy exterior and a soft, chewy interior.

name: LAVO
dsc: LAVO's 20 Layer Chocolate Peanut Butter Cake is a towering masterpiece. This cake features 20 thin layers of chocolate cake alternating with creamy peanut butter frosting. Each slice is a perfect balance of rich chocolate and nutty peanut butter, making it an unforgettable dessert experience.

name: John & Kira's
dsc: John & Kira's Chocolate Bees with Caramelized Honey Center are a unique and whimsical treat. Each chocolate bee is shaped like a cute insect and filled with a sweet, caramelized honey center. The combination of rich chocolate and honey is simply irresistible.

name: Sugar Plum
dsc: Sugar Plum's Heart Shaped Chocolate Pizza comes with a mallet for a fun and interactive chocolate experience. This chocolate pizza is made with premium chocolate and topped with candies and nuts. Breaking it with the mallet adds a playful element to any celebration.

name: Lady M Confections
dsc: Lady M Confections' Chocolate Mille Crêpes Cake is a work of art. This cake features 20 delicate crêpes layered with rich chocolate pastry cream. The result is a light, elegant cake that is perfect for any celebration. Each slice is a perfect balance of textures.

name: Carousel Cakes
dsc: Carousel Cakes' Chocolate Outrage Cake is a rich and decadent dessert that lives up to its name. This cake features layers of chocolate cake with chocolate mousse filling and a rich chocolate frosting. It's topped with chocolate curls and is perfect for any chocolate lover.

name: Carlo's Bakery
dsc: Carlo's Bakery Chocolate Fudge Rainbow Cake is a vibrant and delicious dessert. This cake features layers of chocolate fudge cake with colorful rainbow frosting and sprinkles. It's perfect for birthdays, celebrations, or any occasion that calls for a pop of color.

name: Jacques Torres Chocolate
dsc: Jacques Torres' World Famous Chocolate Chip Cookies 12-pack is perfect for sharing with family and friends. Each cookie is made with a secret recipe that uses premium chocolate chunks and a buttery dough. The cookies are baked fresh and have a perfect balance of crispy edges and a soft, chewy center.

name: The Model Bakery
dsc: The Model Bakery's Chocolate Rads are a Napa Valley favorite. These chocolate chip cookies are baked with a generous amount of premium chocolate and are the perfect balance of sweet and buttery. This 4-pack is perfect for a quick treat or sharing with friends.

name: Breads Bakery
dsc: Breads Bakery's Chocolate and Cinnamon Babka 3-pack includes three of their most popular babkas. Each babka is rich, buttery, and filled with either chocolate or cinnamon. The bread is braided and baked to perfection, resulting in a soft, fluffy texture with a slightly crisp crust.

name: John & Kira's
dsc: John & Kira's Signature Chocolate Gift Tower is a stunning presentation of premium chocolates. This tower features multiple tiers of beautifully crafted chocolates in a variety of flavors and designs. It makes a memorable and impressive gift for any occasion.

name: Savannah's Candy Kitchen
dsc: Savannah's Candy Kitchen Chocolate Candy Striped Gift Tin is a festive and delicious gift. This tin is filled with a variety of chocolate candies, including turtles, clusters, and bark. The colorful tin makes it perfect for gifting during the holidays.

name: Goldberg's Fine Foods
dsc: Goldberg's Fine Foods Flourless Chocolate Cake is a rich and decadent dessert that is naturally gluten-free. This cake is made with high-quality chocolate and has a dense, fudgy texture that is incredibly satisfying. It's perfect for those with dietary restrictions or anyone who loves intense chocolate flavor.

name: Danny Macaroons
dsc: Danny Macaroons' Chocolate Dipped Macaroons are a classic New York treat. These macaroons are made with shredded coconut and topped with a generous layer of rich chocolate. Each bite is a perfect combination of chewy coconut and smooth chocolate.

name: Jessie's Nutty Cups
dsc: Jessie's Nutty Cups Dark Chocolate Nutty Cups Assortment features a variety of chocolate cups filled with different nuts like almonds, hazelnuts, and pistachios. Each cup is made with premium dark chocolate and is a delicious and healthy snack option.

name: Chukar Cherries
dsc: Chukar Cherries' Chocolate Cherries and Nuts Sumptuous Assortment features a delicious combination of chocolate-covered cherries and nuts. Each piece is made with premium chocolate and real fruit, creating a perfect balance of sweet and tart flavors.

name: Michele's Pies
dsc: Michele's Pies Chocolate Pecan Bourbon Pie is a Southern classic with a grown-up twist. This pie features a rich chocolate filling with toasted pecans and a hint of bourbon. The combination of flavors creates a sophisticated and delicious dessert that is perfect for any occasion.

name: Mini Melanie
dsc: Mini Melanie's Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake is a fun and delicious twist on a classic cookie. This cookie cake is baked in a cake pan and topped with a generous amount of chocolate chips. It's perfect for birthdays, celebrations, or any occasion that calls for a sweet treat.

name: Lou Malnati's Pizza
dsc: This combo pack from Lou Malnati's includes two of their famous deep dish pizzas and a Lezza Chocolate Cake. The pizzas are Chicago-style with a buttery crust, while the chocolate cake is rich and fudgy. This is the perfect meal for a game day or family gathering.

name: Colts Chocolate
dsc: Colts Chocolate's Chocolate Marshmallows are a delightful treat. These marshmallows are coated in rich chocolate, creating a perfect combination of fluffy and creamy textures. They are perfect for snacking, roasting, or adding to hot cocoa.

name: Chesapeake Bay Gourmet
dsc: Chesapeake Bay Gourmet's Chocolate Peanut Butter Smith Island Cake is a Maryland classic. This cake features layers of chocolate and peanut butter cake with a rich fudge icing. Each slice is a delicious combination of flavors that is sure to satisfy any sweet tooth.

name: Rustika Cafe and Bakery
dsc: Rustika Cafe and Bakery's Chocolate Fudge Cake is an 8-inch masterpiece. This cake features layers of moist chocolate cake with a rich chocolate fudge frosting. It is baked fresh and is perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, or any special occasion.

name: Carlo's Bakery
dsc: Carlo's Bakery Jumbo Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake is a giant cookie that is perfect for parties and celebrations. This cookie cake is topped with a generous amount of chocolate chips and is baked until golden and chewy. It can be personalized with a message for any occasion.

name: Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate
dsc: This Kreuther Handcrafted Chocolate combo includes a dozen double chocolate almond fudge cookies and a dozen chocolate chip cookies. Both varieties are made with premium ingredients and baked to perfection. This is the ultimate cookie gift for any chocolate lover.

name: Red Truck Bakery
dsc: Red Truck Bakery's Triple Chocolate Cake is a chocolate lover's paradise. This cake features three layers of rich chocolate cake with chocolate ganache filling and chocolate buttercream frosting. It's indulgent, moist, and absolutely irresistible.

name: Wilbur's of Maine Chocolate Confections
dsc: Wilbur's of Maine Chocolate Confections presents Wilbur the Chocolate Moose, a charming and delicious chocolate sculpture. This 2-pack features two moose-shaped chocolates that are perfect for gifting or adding to a holiday display. A true Maine specialty.

name: Little Grace Bakery
dsc: Little Grace Bakery's Dutch Chocolate Basque Burnt Cheesecake is a gluten-free dessert that is rich, creamy, and slightly caramelized on top. This cheesecake has a deep chocolate flavor and a smooth, silky texture. It's a unique and delicious dessert for those who are gluten-sensitive.

name: Blue Owl Bakery
dsc: Blue Owl Bakery's Chocolate Passion Layer Cake is a stunning dessert that features layers of rich chocolate cake with a creamy chocolate filling. The cake is covered in a smooth chocolate frosting and decorated with elegant chocolate curls. A perfect cake for any celebration.
